metadata.input: Playwright synthetic mouse events in headless Chromium; does not measure physical input-to-photon latency.

method.pointGesture: Five point drags; each uses 12 pointer moves 42px right and 22px up from its current visible point location. Record actual endpoint and board geometry for every trial.
method.nativeRangeGesture: Find by associated label and min/max, scroll into view, then 10 pointer moves alternating between approximately 18% and 82% of the track. Capture input value and board geometry at each endpoint; assert both change.
method.farinGesture: Find JSXGraph Farin slider, map board coordinates through JSXGraph Coords plus container offset, move glider 10 steps alternating between 18% and 82%, and verify ratio and curve geometry change.
method.raw: Per-trial wall time includes synthetic pointer dispatch, checkpoint reads, and 32 ms settling. Also record pointermove counts, board.update calls, observed pointer-to-first-board-DOM-mutation delays, and requestAnimationFrame intervals. p95 uses nearest-rank; with five repeats it equals the maximum.
